questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of self-assessment in discovering your passion for a side hustle?

options.text: To compare your skills with your friends’ skills
To identify your personal interests, hobbies, and strengths that can guide your hustle
To decide how much money you want to earn immediately
To copy successful entrepreneurs’ ideas

correct_answer.text: To identify your personal interests, hobbies, and strengths that can guide your hustle

questions.question_text: How can a hobby like cooking be turned into a hustle according to the chapter?

options.text: By cooking only for family and not charging anything
By starting a YouTube channel without any planning
By offering products like mini idli packs or services like teaching recipes to neighbors
By spending a lot of money on a professional kitchen setup first

correct_answer.text: By offering products like mini idli packs or services like teaching recipes to neighbors

questions.question_text: Why is it important to consider market needs when planning a side hustle?

options.text: Because your passion alone guarantees success
Because a hustle only works if people want or need what you offer
Because market needs are irrelevant to teen businesses
Because you should ignore your skills and only focus on trends

correct_answer.text: Because a hustle only works if people want or need what you offer

questions.question_text: What is a practical step suggested in the chapter for brainstorming your first hustle idea?

options.text: Waiting for someone else to give you an idea
Combining your passion, hobby, skill, and a market need to create a simple plan
Spending a large amount of money on advertising before starting
Ignoring feedback from friends and family

correct_answer.text: Combining your passion, hobby, skill, and a market need to create a simple plan

questions.question_text: Which of the following is an example of a skill that a teen might turn into a hustle, as discussed in the chapter?

options.text: Watching TV all day without any goal
Organizing events like Durga Puja or school projects for others
Avoiding schoolwork and responsibilities
Spending money on expensive gadgets without a plan

correct_answer.text: Organizing events like Durga Puja or school projects for others
